policy: Use everything-claude-code as the first collection and curation source when importing or refreshing candidate agents, commands, and skills. Do not lock the system to ECC only; allow other repos and manual additions whenever they are a better fit.
fallback_policy: Use openai-skills first for focused, high-signal security or curated specialist gaps.
Use antigravity-kit for simple portable roles/workflows when ECC coverage is absent or too tool-specific.
Use broad catalogs like antigravity-awesome-skills mainly for discovery, not as the first active-core source.
Manual project-local or hand-curated additions always remain allowed.
